cbv6:0.1: The Discourse on the Ten Things
cbv6:2.1: This is what the Great Sage preached about the qualities of the monks,
cbv6:3.1: after hearing it, and while practising, he is freed from all suffering.
cbv6:4.1: For the whole world’s benefit and welfare we will recite that safeguard.

cbv6:11.1: and the Fortunate One said this:
cbv6:25.2: and those monks were uplifted and greatly rejoiced in the Fortunate One’s words.
